role: Independent native curve scan-conversion diagnostics. All source and fitted coordinates, complete translated native textures and independently inverted binary cell maps are retained. No texture or glyph identity is a product input.
mode: NATURAL_SYMMETRIC; NATURAL measuring; CLEARTYPE_3x1. Both enabled and disabled grid fitting produce identical retained textures.
recipe: Private two-glyph TrueType replay fonts, UPEM 4096/em 64, baseline (8,256), caller-named face 0, hmtx left bearing xMin, no glyph instructions, fpgm or CVT; prep SCANCTRL 511 and the declared SCANTYPE. Synthetic split cases use exact De Casteljau subdivision. Every authored and independently observed fitted coordinate is integer F26. S32 replays the independently fitted public-face outline; its original unchanged native texture agrees.
qualification: Every texture and bound agrees through three fresh native processes per translation, in both grid-fit modes. Each cell map exactly reconstructs all 30 native textures, including zero bytes and an outside margin; inversion has no incompatible observations, nonintegral row counts or nonbinary cells.

sampling.bitmapOrder: Top-down rows; most significant bit first; zero outside cellBounds.

s32Isolation: Cropping to original contour points 39,40,41,42,0,1,2,3 preserves all covered cells in fine rows 1274..1279. Exact analytic coverage and the diagnostic FreeType high-precision raster add the same three cells; neither misses a native cell.
